_meta.note: Ventana de las votaciones nominales puntuadas.

methodology: score_executive = matches / votes_cast across curated executive-position list. score_bloc = matches with own-bloc majority (>=60%) / votes_cast. rate_absent = absences / listed_total. Only votes actually held by the legislator's own chamber count towards the denominators (see listed_votes_by_chamber); a vote the other chamber held is recorded as N/A, not as an absence. Source positions: src/data/executivePositions.json
